description.value: Grays Cafe is a sister-owned neighbourhood café in Sidney by the Sea, opened in 2021 by sisters Lisa and Amy who built it around locally sourced ingredients — coffee from Drumroaster, local produce, baked goods, and meat. The breakfast-and-lunch menu spans wraps, bagels, salads, and smoothies with a strong vegetarian and vegan lean. It bills itself as a place for community gathering, making it a welcoming mid-ride stop in the heart of Sidney.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 82m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at https://www.grayscafe.ca/ loaded successfully and provides the address (2520 Bevan Ave Sidney BC, V8L 1W3), email (grayscafe@outlook.com), and a detailed menu. The menu clearly labels multiple vegan items (Vegan Just Egg, vegan smoked gouda, vegan feta) and GF granola, confirming vegetarian/vegan/GF options. No bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout policy, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM name 'Gray's Cafe' includes an apostrophe that the website consistently omits ('Grays Cafe').
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Gray's Cafe' (with apostrophe) but the business website consistently spells it 'Grays Cafe' (no apostrophe).
No phone number is present in OSM tags or anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating café in Sidney with a current website (copyright 2026), detailed menu, and confirmed address. A practical mid-ride food stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegan items (Breakfast Bagel with Vegan Just Egg and vegan smoked gouda; Kidney Bean Wrap; House Salad and Veggie Wrap with vegan feta) and GF granola in the Yogurt Cup; numerous vegetarian options throughout breakfast and lunch sections

wow_evidence: sister-owned neighbourhood café... locally sourced ingredients — coffee from Drumroaster, local produce... place for community gathering
